raw_response:
A is not well-posed as a non-circular bridge back to Window6/Fibonacci. It is only well-posed as a negative-control diagnostic on Window6 itself.
The core obstruction is that the codon  $E_1$  result and the Window6/Fibonacci object do not live in a shared canonical spectral frame.
On the codon side,

$$H(3,4)=V_4^3$$

has a canonical product structure: three codon positions, each carrying four chemical states. Its  $E_1$  layer means additive dependence on a single codon position. Because the  $V_4$  coordinates are chemical characters, the localization to position 3, position 1, weak/strong, and purine/pyrimidine has a real codon-chemical interpretation.
Window6 is different. It is

$$X_6=\{x\in\{0,1\}^6:\text{no adjacent 1s}\},
\quad |X_6|=21,$$

an induced subgraph or subset of the Boolean cube  $Q_6$ . Its natural spectral language is Boolean Fourier degree on six bits, or the adjacency/Laplacian spectrum of the Fibonacci cube  $\Gamma_6$ . Neither is canonically the same as codon  $E_1$  in  $V_4^3$ .
You can compute Window6’s own spectral order:

$$f_W=\mathbf{1}_{X_6}-21/64$$

on  $Q_6$ , with Boolean Fourier expansion

$$f_W=\sum_{S\subseteq[6]}\hat f(S)\chi_S.$$

Then define degree energies

$$\rho_k(W)=
\frac{\sum_{|S|=k}\hat f(S)^2}
{\sum_{S\neq\varnothing}\hat f(S)^2},
\quad k=1,\ldots,6.$$

A clean pre-registered null would be all  $21$ -vertex subsets of  $Q_6$  with the same internal edge count  $38$ , and ideally the same coordinate-marginal multiset. If Window6 has extreme  $\rho_1$ ,  $\rho_2$ , or high-degree energy under that null, that certifies a property of Window6 as a Boolean constraint.
But it does not certify a bridge to the codon  $E_1$  residual. Boolean degree-1 means dependence on one bit. Codon  $E_1$  means dependence on one codon position, with a four-state chemical character. Those are only analogous after one chooses a grouping of six bits into three pairs. That grouping is not forced by Window6. Choosing it because it helps match codons would recreate the q6/convention circularity the bridge already ruled out.
If you test all  $15$  pairings of six bits into three unordered pairs, two outcomes are possible. If only special pairings produce alignment, the result is convention-dependent. If all pairings produce alignment, it is a generic feature of Window6 or of the size/edge profile, not a specific codon bridge. Either way, it does not create a new forcing channel.
So the honest status is:
The bio  $E_1$  result should not be pulled back into Window6.
It says the translation-residual basis is dominated by ordinary additive codon chemistry: wobble, position 1, weak/strong, and purine/pyrimidine. That is biologically meaningful, but it is not the hoped-for high-frequency  $E_3$  contact and not a Fibonacci signature.
The only remaining pure-math/public-data step is a negative-control appendix: compute Window6’s Boolean Fourier degree profile and show that any proposed comparison to codon  $E_1$  requires an extra non-canonical coordinate pairing. That is useful for closure, not for discovery.
Therefore:
the bridge is correctly bio-gated; the decisive next input is the expanded organism set for the held-out cross-organism gate.
The structural program is genuinely exhausted as a bridge program. It has produced a clean outcome: the codon spectral residual lives in first-order base chemistry, while Window6/Fibonacci cannot be non-circularly identified with that  $E_1$  layer.
The sharpest next question is: In a larger held-out organism panel, does the certified codon- $E_1$  wobble/position-1 residual remain reproducible after tRNA-tAI, TE, clade, and composition controls, or is it only a codon-spelling artifact?
